g.title: crate Writes a recorded Kivact drawing as an SVG 1.1 document.
crate::document Writes one recorded drawing as the text of an SVG 1.1 document.
crate::document::tests Tests of the whole document and of the nesting of its groups.
crate::emit Turns each recorded draw command into SVG markup, in order.
crate::emitter The state of one SVG export: markup, definitions and the host.
crate::encode Number, color, XML text and PNG encoding of the SVG document.
crate::encode::tests Tests of number, color, escaping and the PNG data URI.
crate::error The error of an SVG export, by the kind the host reports it as.
crate::fill Writes fills and strokes as SVG paints and the gradients they use.
crate::image Embeds images in the SVG document as PNG data URIs.
crate::resources The answers the SVG writer asks of the renderer that recorded it.
crate::shape Resolves drawn shapes to path commands and writes SVG path data.
crate::shape::tests Tests of the SVG path data of lines, closed contours and arcs.
crate::text Writes one line of drawn text as an SVG `<text>` element.
